This is something I've never seen before. This app lets you get more fps, in any game, which can be launched in windowed/windowed fullscreen mode. In my opinion the best effect is in games, which have a hard cap of fps. Lossless Scaling lets you "see" more frames, which means that you can play games like The Binding of Isaac, Hollow Knight, or Terraria in more than 60 fps. As you can see I have many hours in this program, because for these games it's amazing. It can also help make more demanding games, more playable, thanks to generating more frames, and game running overall smoother.

This is a cheap way to increase frame rates, if you don't mind the interpolated frames in between the frames your game actually renders. It's not necessarily a boost to increase performance, but a way to "trick" your screen (and eyes) that the game is running in higher frame rates.

If you simply can't be bothered to overclock your system or have no funds to upgrade your rig, this one is an inexpensive alternative that scratches the 60fps itch in many PC gamers.

I don't see a lot of reviews mention this, but this tool is really useful to upscale from 720p windowed to fullscreen for a "borderless windowed" type experience with virtually zero input lag.

It's very useful for me when playing on older systems using a multi monitor setup where borderless fullscreen isn't supported/doesn't run well and I can't use actual fullscreen because it's a PIA to have everything resize when I alt+tab.

Haven't played with the upscaling settings that much but it's a very versatile tool so far.

Complete game changer for slower-paced games like Microsoft Flight Simulator. Huge increase of perceivable FPS with no loss of visuals. If you can deal with slower mouse movements for these slower-paced games and need a considerable FPS boost, this is the best £5.89 you'll spend
